Propagation algorithm:
```
def propagate(dom):
    # dom is dict var->set
    changed=True
    while changed:
       changed=False
       # singleton all-diff
       for group in groups:
           # if any domain singleton, remove value from all others
           fixed_vals=set()
           for v in group:
               if len(dom[v])==1:
                   val=next(iter(dom[v]))
                   # check duplicates among fixed
                   if val in fixed_vals: return None
                   fixed_vals.add(val)
           for v in group:
               if len(dom[v])>1:
                   for val in fixed_vals:
                       if val in dom[v]:
                           dom[v].remove(val); changed=True
                           if not dom[v]: return None
       # For each binary constraint, arc consistency one pass
       for (x,y,rel) in constraints:
           # if same variable? none
           newx=set()
           for a in dom[x]:
               if any(rel(a,b) for b in dom[y]):
                   newx.add(a)
           if newx != dom[x]:
               dom[x]=newx; changed=True
               if not dom[x]: return None
           newy=set()
           for b in dom[y]:
               if any(rel(a,b) for a in dom[x]):
                   newy.add(b)
           if newy != dom[y]:
               dom[y]=newy; changed=True
               if not dom[y]: return None
       # Also unary constraints should already initial, but can include
    return dom
```

    educations = ["high school", "bachelor", "doctorate", "master", "associate"]
    animals = ["cat", "fish", "dog", "horse", "bird"]

    name_candidates = []

        if d["Arnold"] + 1 == d["Peter"]:
            name_candidates.append(d)

def ac3(dom):
    q=deque()
    for x in vars_order:
        for y in neighbors[x]:
            q.append((x,y))
    while q:
       xi,xj = q.popleft()
       revised=False
       # for each val in dom[xi]
       for xval in list(dom[xi]):
           # check any yval in dom[xj] satisfying all predicates for arc xi->xj
           supported=False
           for yval in dom[xj]:
               ok=True
               for pred in neighbors[xi][xj]:
                   if not pred(xval,yval):
                       ok=False
                       break
               if ok:
                   supported=True
                   break
           if not supported:
               dom[xi].remove(xval)
               revised=True
       if revised:
           if not dom[xi]:
               return False
           # If xi changed, add arcs (xk,xi) for all xk in neighbors[xi]
           for xk in neighbors[xi]:
               q.append((xk,xi))
    return True
